name: TMT & WHO-ATC Cloud Automated ETL & Agentic Pipeline

parameters.name: query
parameters.value: SELECT ?itemLabel ?atc WHERE { ?item wdt:P267 ?atc. FILTER(REGEX(?atc, '^[A-Z][0-9]{2}[A-Z]{2}[0-9]{2}$')) SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language 'en'. } }
